'''Dean and Lorana Jinzler's father''' was the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of four children, including [[Lorana Jinzler|Lorana]] and [[Dean Jinzler|Dean]].

==Biography==
Jinzler and his [[Dean and Lorana Jinzler's mother|wife]] were civilian workers in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where they worked handling electronics maintenance and repairs in the public areas. Jinzler and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] adored and honored the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and took each of [[Jinzler family|their children]] to be tested for [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force sensitivity]]. After their third child [[Lorana Jinzler|Lorana]] was inducted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at the age of ten [[Standard month/Legends|months]], Jinzler and his wife lost their jobs as [[Technician/Legends|maintenance engineers]] in the Temple. They both knew that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] rules forbade members of the Order from knowing their family, as to prevent attachments.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

After Jinzler and his wife were fired from the Temple, they found lower-paying jobs, where they had scramble just to get the family packed and moved, as no one told them they could not stay at the Temple once Lorana was inducted into the Jedi Order. Despite moving to a new home away from the Temple, Jinzler and his wife tracked their [[Gender/Legends|daughter's]] [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] in the Jedi Order as [[Jorus C'baoth]]'s [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] through a friend who still worked in the Temple. Jinzler and his wife later gave an [[Amethyst/Legends|amethyst]] to a group of [[Coruscanti/Legends|citizens]] once rescued by Lorana and C'baoth. The citizens gifted the amethyst gem to Lorana. Lorana used the amethyst gem alongside an [[activation stud]] to ignite her [[Lorana Jinzler's lightsaber|lightsaber]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

Jinzler's youngest child [[Dean Jinzler|Dean]] did not have much [[The Force/Legends|Force]] potential, just like his two eldest siblings. Despite Jinzler and his wife giving Dean the same love they gave their other children, Dean became jealous of Lorana and felt his parents worshipped her. They set up a shrine in their home to honor Lorana. Whenever Dean got in trouble, Jinzler and his wife told Dean that Lorana would never have done those actions. As a result, Dean grew to despise Lorana and both his parents. After the [[Battle for Outbound Flight]], Lorana assigned [[Jorj Car'das]] to leave the [[Starship/Legends|starship]], head to Coruscant and tell Dean to release his anger to Lorana and his [[Parent/Legends|parents]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="Survivor's date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' establishes the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' took place in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].</ref> forty-nine [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the Battle for Outbound Flight, Car'das sent a message to Dean, informing him of the [[Expedition to Outbound Flight|mission]] to ''[[Outbound Flight]]'s'' remains on a [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] in [[The Redoubt/Legends|the Redoubt]]. The visit to the location of his sister's death made Dean realize Lorana had sacrificed herself to save ''Outbound Flight's'' [[Survivors (Outbound Flight)|Survivors]]. Dean subsequently released all the hate he had to Lorana and his parents.<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>
